purpose: Five tests where NotebookLM was given incorrect MOOS-IvP code and asked to correct it.

manualReview.note: Caught the important bug: unhandled params must delegate to IvPBehavior::setParam so standard params like condition/pwt/duration/updates still work. Caution: snippet handles custom param before base delegation, while local core examples commonly check IvPBehavior::setParam(param,val) first.

Correctly rejects direct DESIRED_HEADING/DESIRED_SPEED posts, uses checked getBufferDoubleVal, builds course/speed ZAICs, couples with OF_Coupler, and returns an IvPFunction. Caution: it did not explicitly add constructor-side addInfoVars("NAV_X, NAV_Y") in the visible correction.

Caught missing m_domain and missing setPWT(m_priority_wt), but proposed ZAIC_PEAK spd_zaic(m_domain, vindex). Local lib_ivpbuild declares ZAIC_PEAK(IvPDomain, const std::string&), and core examples use ZAIC_PEAK zaic(m_domain, "speed"). This is a real source-level correction error.

Correctly adds AppCastingMOOSApp::OnNewMail, type checks with IsDouble, keeps per-message odometry accumulation in the mail loop, publishes from Iterate, and calls PostReport. Missing RegisterVariables from the checker is acceptable because the prompt was specifically about the mail handler pattern.

Correctly recommends AppCastingMOOSApp::OnStartUp, reportUnhandledConfigWarning, calling registration, and AppCastingMOOSApp::RegisterVariables. But it incorrectly claimed lowercase registerVariables is wrong because CMOOSApp expects an uppercase RegisterVariables virtual. Local generated/app examples use lowercase registerVariables as a helper called from OnConnectToServer/OnStartUp; the real problem in the snippet is not calling it, not the helper name.
